**Prepared:** April 2, 2026

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Vendor | Northwind Supply (confirmed active on vendor list) |
| Invoice number | A-1043 |

| Check | Source | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Vendor exists and is active | Vendor master | ✅ Match |

| Quantity billed = quantity ordered | PO #7781 | ✅ Match — 24 = 24 |
| Price billed = price ordered | PO #7781 | ✅ Match — $45.00 = $45.00, extension $1,080.00 correct |
| Quantity billed = quantity received | Receiving record, March 12, 2026 | ✅ Match — 24 cases received |
| Duplicate invoice number | AP invoice register | ❌ **FAIL — A-1043 already on file** |

**Finding**

The invoice matches the purchase order and the receipt on every field: vendor, PO, quantity, unit price, and total. The arithmetic is correct (24 × $45.00 = $1,080.00) and there is no price or quantity variance to dispute.

The invoice cannot be paid, because **this exact invoice has already been processed.** Our AP register shows invoice #A-1043 from Northwind Supply, $1,080.00, against PO #7781, matched and approved on **March 14, 2026** — two days after the 24 cases were received on March 12. Either way, it is one invoice, and it is payable once.

**Conclusion**

Invoice #A-1043 as received April 2, 2026 is a **duplicate submission**. Approving it would pay Northwind Supply $1,080.00 twice for a single delivery of 24 cases of paper.
